column1: # client|skill root relative to the designated home
# The shared tree (~/.agents/skills) is the portable home of the library. A
# client that also scans a root of its own discovers the same name twice: it
# keeps the first copy and warns about the second. The client root therefore
# holds only names the shared tree does not provide, and the deployment
# OpenCode scans its default root next to the configured profile root, so a
# device entry there repeats a profile name. The deployment owns neither root
# separately: it reports the duplicate and never writes there.
